releases.title: September Platform & Mobile Updates
releases.overview: Welcome to the latest version of CISA Campus Work Tracker! This update introduces custom release announcements, enhanced contact ownership tools, and expanded mobile navigation.

items.text: Fast keyboard shortcuts and global search with ⌘K palette
Interactive QR Bible study reader and editor
Filter News Feed by team and teammate
Two-phase Test Account Purge tool in Administrative Settings
Touch targets and action layout optimizations across all screens
Simplified prayer fold and history tracking
Contact owner transfer when owner is unassigned and you are the creator
